attchmntText: Pursuant to Regulation 47 (1) and Regulation 30 read with Para A, Part A of Schedule Il of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, please find attached herewith copies of the Newspaper Advertisement published regarding extract of the Unaudited Financial Results for the Second Quarter & Half Year ended 30th September 2026 in the newspapers: Business Standard Mumbai Ahmedabad Edition and Jai Hind Rajkot Gujarati.

The Board of Directors at its meeting held today i.e. Wednesday, 4th November 2026 has inter-alia considered and approved the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone & Consolidated) for the Second Quarter & Half Year ended 30th September 2026
